Text.value: Enjoy a peaceful location close to the historic Sultanahmet District at the Holiday Inn Istanbul City hotel. Set within the old city walls 44 km from Istanbul New Airport our elegant hotel blends traditional Turkish architecture with contemporary style. Surf the web with complimentary wireless internet in your guest room and lounge by our sparkling outdoor pool. The tram outside Holiday Inn Istanbul City speeds you to world famous attractions like the blue mosque and grand bazaar. Holiday Inn Istanbul City has 5 meeting rooms and a lavish ballroom for up to 600 people. There is plenty of onsite parking for your guests. Feel free to access the internet via the 2 pcs in our lobby available 24 hours a day. Barter for the best prices on glittering jewelry, aromatic spices and hand painted ceramics at the grand bazaar in Old Istanbul. For an evening of al fresco dining accompanied by traditional live music take the tram to bustling Taksim Square. Holiday Inn Istanbul Citys laidback tea lounge offers hot drinks and homemade cakes while the pizza kitchen serves Turkish kebabs and Italian pasta dishes. Work up an appetite in our Pilates studio and fitness centre and unwind in the steam room sauna and mosaic tiled Turkish hammam.
Cancel policies and Early Departure Fees vary by hotel. Since a hotel can set a cancellation policy of up to 30 days in advance please review policy prior to booking to avoid possible charge.
Guarantee required for all arrivals vary by hotel. Please review the availability and rate rules for hotel guarantee. Accepted for guarantee are credit card and pre-approved IATA ARC numbers
